messages:
nora: Kicking off canary for osmium14b int4 on pool-small. Quick heads-up: hitting intermittent OOMs when requests ask for long generations (>700). logs below.
diego: Can you paste config and error snippet?
nora: Config: microbatch=1 batch=5 prefetch_window=160 prefetch_padding=0 max_new_tokens=1024. Error: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory allocating 1.2 GiB
Note: slab allocator: free_contig=640MB total_free=2.0GB
Timeline: prefetch->kv_load->decode```
su: That free_contig vs total_free is fragmentation. Quantized layout + large prefetch makes contiguous allocations brittle. Reduce prefetch_window and cap max_new_tokens for canary.
ben: Two quick mitigations: 1) conservative canary defaults: max_new_tokens=512, prefetch_window=48, prefetch_padding=32; 2) runtime fallback: on alloc failure try a 150ms slab-compact then retry, else soft-evict oldest KV pages up to 20%. I'll prototype.
diego: Run a sweep with both changes. If quality drops we need to check truncation artifacts. Post artifacts to s3://redwood-bench/osmium14b/int4/kvcompact-2026-03-28
deploy-bot: :rocket: starting canary deploy osmium14b-int4 -> pool-small-canary-2
ben: Prototype landed in feature/kv-compact. Microbench: p95 +3%, OOMs -> 0 on 1k run. Need full eval.
jira-bot: Created ML-1602: "osmium14b-int4 onboarding: conservative defaults + kv-compact fallback"
su: I'll run summarization+longform sweep and check ROUGE/BERTScore/attention n-gram churn. If delta <=2 pts and perf hit <5% we can promote.
nora: Thanks team, will post results. Keeping canary defaults conservative for now. :thumbsup:
